description: Mikrotik RouterOS static DNS, /ip/dns/static, over its API. RouterOS finds a name's records by its exact letters, capitals too: those of a hostname whose capitals change in the configuration stay, to be removed by hand. See docs/mikrotik.md.

address.description: The router, with a port unless the default: 8728, or 8729 with TLS.

use_tls.description: The API over TLS, the api-ssl service. Without it, the password crosses the network in the clear.

tls_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the router's certificate, in hex: with it, that certificate and no other is accepted, valid or not. Without it, the certificate must be valid. It needs use_tls: true.

username.description: A user with the read, write and api policies.

zone.description: The zone of the names: lan.
